mapper.select: SELECT pd."id", pd.images_url, pi.spu, pd.sku, pd."name", pp.actual_arrival_num, pp.arrival_state, pi.pirate_risk, pc.retail_price, pd.product_state, pd.create_user_id, pd.create_time, pd.spec_type FROM product_info pi INNER JOIN product_detail pd ON pi.id = pd.product_id LEFT JOIN product_purchase pp ON pp.sku_id = pd."id" LEFT JOIN product_cost pc ON pc.sku_id = pd."id" WHERE pi.spu LIKE concat('%',#{sku},'%') OR pd.sku LIKE concat('%',#{sku},'%')

SELECT pi."id", pd.images_url, pd.sku, pd.product_state, pi."name", pi.charge_name, pi.brand_name, pi.property, pi.grade, pi.category, pi.sale_method, pi.product_sell_spot, pi.product_function_desc, pi.usage_desc, pi.pirate_risk, pi.materials, pd.plan_listing_time, pd.unit_id, pd.product_state FROM product_info pi INNER JOIN product_detail pd on pi.id = pd.product_id WHERE pi.id = #{productId}

SELECT pi."id", pd.images_url, pi.spu, pi."name", pi.charge_name, pi.brand_name, pi.property, pi.grade, pi.category, pi.sale_method, pi.product_sell_spot, pi.product_function_desc, pi.usage_desc, pi.pirate_risk, pi.materials FROM product_info pi INNER JOIN product_detail pd on pi.id = pd.product_id WHERE pi.id = #{productId}
